hints: The numbers jump up and down. The list is two series taking turns.
Write the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th numbers as one series: 50, 45, ___, 35.
The series 50, 45, ___, 35 goes down by the same amount each time. Find the step from 50 to 45, take it away from 45, and check that you reach 35.

steps.action: The numbers go up and down in turns, so split the list into two series.
Take the 1st, 3rd, 5th and 7th numbers: 1, 3, 9, 27. The rule is ×3.
Take the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th numbers: 50, 45, ___, 35. The blank is the 6th number, so it belongs here.
Check the difference: 50 − 45 = 5. The rule is −5.
Check: 40 − 5 = 35, which matches the 8th number. The missing number is 40.

trapNotes.18: 18 is halfway between 9 and 27, the numbers beside the blank. But the blank belongs to the second series (50, 45, ___, 35), not the first.
trapNotes.27: This is 9 × 3, the next number of the first series. But 27 is already the 7th number. The blank is the 6th number, which belongs to the second series: 50, 45, ___, 35.
trapNotes.30: This takes 5 away from 35, the last number in the list. But in the series 50, 45, ___, 35, the blank comes right after 45, so take 5 away from 45 instead: 45 − 5.
